summary: Tested admin login regression for SESI RESEPSI. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed covering Biyan/Asty/owner-email login, case-insensitive alias, protected /api/auth/me and /api/bookings with owner token, and safe error responses. Frontend: Playwright end-to-end verified /admin/login flow — owner email fikabisadimartyansyah@gmail.com/Biyan2026 navigates to /admin, Biyan and Asty also succeed, invalid password stays on /admin/login with error, placeholder now reads 'Username atau email admin', and mobile 390px viewport keeps inputs/button usable. Reported user bug 'gagal masuk menjadi admin' is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: Passwords are stored in plain-text env vars and compared directly (req.password != account[1]); consider bcrypt hashing per playbook.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login — playbook recommends lockout after 5 failed attempts.
JWT_SECRET is committed inside /app/backend/.env — rotate before production.
Login uses Bearer token in localStorage rather than httpOnly cookies (playbook prefers httpOnly cookies with credentials).
server.py is 538 lines — nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider modularising auth/uploads/settings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth alias for owner email is implemented via ADMIN_BIYAN_EMAIL env var mapped in ADMINS dict (server.py:179-192) with .strip().lower() normalisation. Frontend AdminLogin uses data-testid admin-username/admin-password/admin-login-submit; token stored in localStorage under sr_token. Backend security recommendations (bcrypt, lockout, httpOnly cookies) remain open enhancements — not blocking current functionality.
rca of the issue: Original 401 for owner email happened because ADMINS map only contained Biyan/Asty usernames. Fix adds ADMIN_BIYAN_EMAIL as second key in ADMINS with same Biyan display name/password and normalises input via .strip().lower(), so email and mixed-case variants now authenticate and receive a JWT tied to display name 'Biyan'.
